title_zh: 安徽省民政厅原党组成员、巡视员王佛生接受审查调查
title_en: Wang Fosheng, Former Party Member and Inspector of Anhui Provincial Civil Affairs Department, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 据安徽省纪委监委11月27日消息，安徽省民政厅原党组成员、巡视员王佛生涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Wang Fosheng, former Party member and inspector of the Anhui Provincial Civil Affairs Department, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, the Anhui Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision said on Nov 27.
body_zh:
中新网11月27日电 据安徽省纪委监委消息：安徽省民政厅原党组成员、巡视员王佛生涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受安徽省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
